notes.title: BIG UPDATE - ANIMATIONS ARE HERE!
notes.content:
[p][b]Hello everyone![/b][/p][p]
I’ve been working hard to bring you the biggest update so far, and it’s finally ready. This patch transforms Monstergasm with new features, smoother gameplay, and some long-awaited Videos![/p][p]Here’s what’s new:[/p][list][*][p][b]🔥 Animations instead of static puzzles![/b]
No more solving only still images - now you can unlock and enjoy also full animated scenes.[/p][/*][*][p][b]📖 Reworked Album.[/b]
A cleaner look and new control options make browsing your unlocked content easier and more fun.[/p][/*][*][p][b]🕹️ Cheat Functions.[/b][/p][list][*][p]Press [b]J[/b] to skip the shooter segment and go straight to the puzzle.[/p][/*][*][p]Press [b]R[/b] to instantly solve the puzzle and reveal the full scene.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]⚡ Faster Loading.[/b]
The game now loads significantly quicker, so you can jump right into the action without waiting.[/p][/*][/list][p]This patch marks a big step forward, and it’s only the beginning. Thank you all for your support and don’t forget to leave a review if you enjoy the update, it helps a lot! 💖[/p]
